[EN] To recover the treasure, you need to meet your real enemies face-to-face on the battleground.
[ES] Para recuperar el tesoro, debes enfrentar cara a cara a tus verdaderos enemigos en el campo de batalla.

[EN] You are strong and powerful. Your bravery deserves a reward.
[ES] Eres fuerte y poderoso. Tu valentía merece una recompensa.
